cards.title: Astrology 101 Certification
cards.subtitle: You have learned the first language of the chart.
cards.body:
You have completed the foundational Astrology 101 sequence. That means you now have the beginning vocabulary for reading a chart as a living symbolic system rather than a pile of disconnected definitions.

You have met the signs as styles of expression, the planets as inner functions, the houses as fields of life, the aspects as relationships between parts, and timing as a way of noticing seasons rather than forcing predictions.

The deeper achievement is not memorization. It is discernment. You have started learning how to pause before turning a symbol into a verdict. You have practiced asking better questions: What is this pointing toward? Where does this show up in lived experience? What changes when awareness enters the picture?

Astra treats certification as a marker of participation, attention, and symbolic literacy. It does not mean the mystery has been solved. It means you have earned the next doorway.

From here, astrology becomes less about asking, ‘What am I?’ and more about asking, ‘How do these parts of life speak to one another — and how can I respond with more honesty, freedom, and care?’
cards.excerpt: You have completed Astrology 101 and earned the next doorway into symbolic literacy.
